wiki.effect is raw wikitext from the community wiki (templates such as {{pp|...}} encode per-level formulas, e.g. Barrier 100 + (460-100)/17*(x-1) for level x).
wiki.maps codes: sr Summoner's Rift, ha Howling Abyss, ar Arena, nb Nexus Blitz, tt Twisted Treeline, cs Crystal Scar.

summonerSpells.name: Cleanse
summonerSpells.description: Removes all disables (excluding suppression and airborne) and summoner spell debuffs affecting your champion and gives Tenacity.

wiki.effect: Removes all {{tip|Crowd control|disables}} (excluding {{tip|Airborne}}, {{tip|Nearsight}}, and {{tip|Suppression}}) and {{ccib|Summoner spell icon.png|summoner spell}} [[debuff]]s (excluding {{si|Mark}}) affecting your [[champion]], and grants you 75% {{tip|tenacity}} for 3 seconds.

summonerSpells.name: Exhaust
summonerSpells.description: Slows target enemy champion and reduces their damage dealt.

wiki.effect: Weakens the target enemy [[champion]] for 3 seconds, {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 40% and [[damage modifier|reducing]] their damage dealt by 35%.

summonerSpells.name: Flash
summonerSpells.description: Teleports you a short distance toward your cursor.

wiki.effect: [[Blink]]s your [[champion]] a short distance toward the target location.

summonerSpells.name: Ghost
summonerSpells.description: Gain Move Speed and ignore unit collision for the duration.

wiki.effect: Your [[champion]] ignores [[unit collision]] and gains {{as|{{pp|key=%|24 + (48-24)/17*(x-1)|1 to 20 by 1}} {{sti|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for 10 seconds.

summonerSpells.name: Heal
summonerSpells.description: Restores Health and grants Move Speed to you and target allied champion.

wiki.effect: {{tip|Heals}} your [[champion]] and the allied champion nearest to the cursor for {{pp|80 + (318-80)/17*(x-1)|1 to 20 by 1|color=heal}}, while also granting both of you {{sti|{{as|30% '''bonus total''' movement speed}}}} for 1 second.

summonerSpells.name: Smite
summonerSpells.description: Deals true damage to a monster or minion.

wiki.effect: Deals {{sti|true damage|{{as|600 true damage}}}} to the target medium / large [[monster]] or enemy [[minion]]. Against [[Champion summoned units|pets]], deals {{as|40 true damage}} instead.

summonerSpells.name: Teleport
summonerSpells.description: After a brief channel, become untargetable and travel to an allied unit. Upgrades into Unleashed Teleport, which significantly increases travel speed.

wiki.effect: After {{tip|channel|channeling}} for 3 seconds, removes any [[homestart]] or [[homeguard]] buff and causes your [[champion]] to {{tip|dash}} to the location of the target allied [[turret]], [[minion]], or [[ward]] at the time of cast over {{pp|round=3|0.5 to (4.5*4500)/5000+0.5 for 10;5|0 to 4500;5000+|type=distance to target|label=Seconds|formula=(5-0.5)*distance/5000+0.5}} seconds, during which they are {{tip|untargetable}} and {{tip|lockout|unable to act}}. ''Upgrades to {{si|Unleashed Teleport}} at 10:00.''

summonerSpells.name: Clarity
summonerSpells.description: Restores your and ally champion's Mana.

wiki.effect: Restores {{as|{{sti|mana|50% '''maximum''' mana}}}} to your [[champion]] and {{as|25% of target's '''maximum''' mana}} to nearby allied [[champion]]s.

summonerSpells.name: Ignite
summonerSpells.description: Deals true damage over time to target enemy champion and reduces healing effects on them for the duration.

wiki.effect: Sets the target enemy [[champion]] on fire for 5 seconds, {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them and dealing {{as|{{pp|70; then +20*x for 4;then +25*x|1 to 20 by 1|formula=70 base, then +20 per level until level 5, then +25 per level.}} {{sti|true damage}}}} over the duration, with the first tick of damage occurring briefly after the cast and subsequent ticks occurring every {{fd|1.056}} seconds after the previous. The target is also inflicted with {{tip|Grievous Wounds}} for the same duration.

summonerSpells.name: Barrier
summonerSpells.description: Gain a brief Shield.

wiki.effect: Grants your [[champion]] a {{tip|shield}} that absorbs {{pp|100 + (460-100)/17*(x-1)|1 to 20 by 1}} damage for {{fd|2.5}} seconds.

summonerSpells.name: To the King!
summonerSpells.description: Quickly travel to the Poro King's side.

summonerSpells.name: Poro Toss
summonerSpells.description: Toss a Poro at your enemies. If it hits, you can quickly travel to your target as a follow up.

summonerSpells.name: Mark
summonerSpells.description: Throw a snowball in a straight line at your enemies. If it hits an enemy, they become marked, granting True Sight, and your champion can quickly travel to the marked target as a follow up.

wiki.effect: {{sbc|Active:}} Throw a snowball at a long distance in the target direction, dealing {{as|{{pp|15 to 100}} {{sti|true damage}}}} to the first enemy unit hit, {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them for 3 seconds and granting you the ability to cast {{si|Dash}} for the next 3 seconds.

summonerSpells.name: Mark
summonerSpells.description: Throw a snowball in a straight line at your enemies. If it hits an enemy, they become marked, granting True Sight, and your champion can quickly travel to the marked target as a follow up.

summonerSpells.name: Placeholder
summonerSpells.description: This slot will be replaced by another champion's ultimate selected at the start of the game. There will be 30 seconds to select an ultimate. Be prepared!

summonerSpells.name: Placeholder and Attack-Smite
summonerSpells.description: This slot will be replaced by another champion's ultimate and you will gain Attack-Smite. There will be 30 seconds to select an ultimate. Be prepared!

summonerSpells.name: Cleanse
summonerSpells.description: Removes all disables and summoner spell debuffs affecting your champion and temporarily lowers the duration of incoming disables. Summoner's Resolve: Extends the Tenacity buff duration.

summonerSpells.name: Exhaust
summonerSpells.description: Slows target enemy champion and reduces their Attack Speed and damage dealt. Summoner's Wrath: Exhaust also reduces the target's Armor and Magic Resist by 10.

summonerSpells.name: Flash
summonerSpells.description: Teleports you a short distance toward your cursor. Summoner's Insight: Reduces Flash's Cooldown by 15 seconds.

summonerSpells.name: Clairvoyance
summonerSpells.description: Reveals a small area of the map for your team for a short duration. Summoner's Insight: Retain sight on units revealed by Clairvoyance for 5 seconds.

summonerSpells.name: Ghost
summonerSpells.description: Gain Move Speed and ignore unit collision for the duration. Summoner's Wrath: Bonus Move Speed granted by Ghost is increased.

summonerSpells.name: Heal
summonerSpells.description: Restores Health to your champion and to nearby allies. Summoner's Resolve: Gain 5 Health per level.

summonerSpells.name: Fortify
summonerSpells.description: Grants invulnerability to all Allied Turrets and causes them to attack 100% faster for 6 seconds. Summoner's Resolve: Turrets deal splash damage around their target.

summonerSpells.name: Rally
summonerSpells.description: Summons a temporary beacon which increases allied Attack damage in an area. Summoner's Wrath: Rally additionally gives Ability Power.

summonerSpells.name: Smite
summonerSpells.description: Deals true damage to target enemy minion or pet. Summoner's Resolve: Smite grants 10 gold per cast.

summonerSpells.name: Teleport
summonerSpells.description: After a short channel, your champion teleports to a target allied minion, turret, or ward. Summoner's Insight: Teleport's channel time is reduced.

summonerSpells.name: Clarity
summonerSpells.description: Restores your and ally champions' Mana. Summoner's Insight: Restores more mana.

summonerSpells.name: Ignite
summonerSpells.description: Deals true damage over time to target enemy champion and reduces healing effects on them for the duration. Summoner's Wrath: While Ignite is on cooldown, gain 5 Ability Power and Attack Damage.

summonerSpells.name: Surge
summonerSpells.description: Temporarily empowers your champion, granting Attack Speed  and Ability Power for the duration. Summoner's Wrath: Increases the Attack Speed bonus by 5% and the Ability Power bonus by 10%.

summonerSpells.name: Promote
summonerSpells.description: Promotes a minion, granting it bonus stats, an empowering aura, and causing it to grant the caster gold for its kills. Summoner's Wrath: The Siege Rider's bonus Attack Damage aura also affects Champions.

summonerSpells.name: Barrier
summonerSpells.description: Gain a short duration shield. Summoner's Resolve: Barrier's Shield is increased.

summonerSpells.name: Revive
summonerSpells.description: Instantly revives your champion at your team's Summoner Platform and increases their Movement Speed for a short duration. Summoner's Insight: Revive temporarily grants the user 220-560 Health.

summonerSpells.name: Flee
summonerSpells.description: Gain a short burst of Move Speed, increased while running away from enemy champions.

summonerSpells.name: Flash
summonerSpells.description: Teleports your champion a short distance toward your cursor's location.
